title: An agent reads the same files you edited

buildSteps.label: This deck
buildSteps.description: You are looking at the folder presentations/tutorial-agents. It is text files, like the first tutorial's deck, and an agent edits them the way you did.

buildSteps.label: Its instructions
buildSteps.description: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, at the top of the repository, tell an agent the rules here: a storyboard before slides, a check after every change, no media in git. The skills in .claude/skills are its procedures.

buildSteps.label: The loop
buildSteps.description: You say what you want. The agent edits files. This page reloads by itself, and a task slide looks at the deck and marks itself done.

buildSteps.label: Two windows
buildSteps.description: Keep this page beside the agent's session. Open the session at the top folder of the repository, so that it finds its instructions.
